title: Ang Kapitang Hindi Yumuko
text: Hindi ka yumuko. Sa huling assembly, ikaw ang nagsalita nang una — at ang bayan ay sumunod. Hindi ka naging bayani. Naging halimbawa ka lang. At minsan, sapat na 'yon.
text_en: You didn't bow. At the final assembly, you spoke first — and the town followed. You weren't a hero. You were an example. And sometimes, that's enough.

title: Ang Pirma
text: Pumirma ka. Alam mong mali, pero may nanay kang may sakit, may utang kang binabayaran. Hindi ka masamang tao. Isa ka lang taong napagod. Ang bayan ay nagpatuloy — pero ikaw, hindi na makatulog.
text_en: You signed. You knew it was wrong, but your mother was sick, and you were paying a debt. You're not a bad person. You were just tired. The town moved on — but you stopped sleeping.

title: Ang Badge
text: Suot mo ang badge nang may dangal. Sa huling gabi, tumayo ka sa gitna ng assembly at nagsalita. Ang ilan ay nagalit. Ang bayan ay nakinig. Ang badge ay hindi na mabigat.
text_en: You wear the badge with honor. On the last night, you stood in the middle of the assembly and spoke. Some were angry. The town listened. The badge isn't heavy anymore.

title: Ang Sumunod
text: Sinunod mo ang utos. Mas madali 'yon. Pero sa gabi, naaalala mo ang mukha ng kapitbahay na humingi ng tulong. Hindi ka masama. Natatakot ka lang. At ang takot, minsan, ay sapat na para sumunod.
text_en: You followed orders. That was easier. But at night, you remember the face of the neighbor who asked for help. You're not bad. You were just afraid. And sometimes, fear is enough to make you comply.

title: Ang Tamang Semento
text: Tumanggi kang pumirma. Ang semento ay tama, ang resibo ay totoo. Nawalan ka ng kaibigan sa munisipyo, pero nakuha mo ang sarili mo. Ang mga estudyante mo ay natuto — hindi lang sa aralin, kundi sa halimbawa.
text_en: You refused to sign. The cement is right, the receipt is true. You lost a friend at the hall, but you found yourself. Your students learned — not just from lessons, but from example.

title: Ang Pumikit
text: Pumikit ka. Hindi dahil gusto mo, kundi dahil pagod ka na. Ang proyekto ay itinayo nang mali, at ang baha ay dumating. Minsan, ang katahimikan ay isang pagpili rin — at may bayad ito.
text_en: You looked away. Not because you wanted to, but because you were tired. The project was built wrong, and the flood came. Sometimes silence is also a choice — and it has a price.

title: Ang Boses
text: Ang boses mo ay hindi nag-iisa. Sa assembly, ang isa ay naging marami. Ang bayan ay nagbago — hindi dahil sa'yo, kundi dahil sa lahat ng nagsalita. Ikaw ay isa lang sa kanila. At 'yon ang buong punto.
text_en: Your voice wasn't alone. At the assembly, one became many. The town changed — not because of you, but because of everyone who spoke. You were just one of them. And that's the whole point.

title: Ang Pagod na Boses
text: Nagsalita ka nang mag-isa, at napagod ka. Walang sumama, kaya walang nagbago. Hindi ito pagkabigo mo — ito ang gastos ng pagkilos nang mag-isa. Ang bayan ay naghintay ng iba. Sana ay may sumama.
text_en: You spoke alone, and you burned out. No one joined, so nothing changed. This isn't your failure — it's the cost of acting alone. The town waited for others. I wish someone had joined you.

title: Ang Sumama
text: Hindi ka nagsalita nang una. Pero nang may nagsalita, sumama ka. At ang pagsama mo ang naging dahilan kung bakit naging marami ang boses. Hindi ka bayani. Isa kang kapitbahay. At ang kapitbahay, minsan, ang pinakamahalaga.
text_en: You didn't speak first. But when someone did, you joined. And your joining is why the voices became many. You're not a hero. You're a neighbor. And neighbors, sometimes, are the most important thing.

title: Ang Nanood
text: Nanood ka lang. Ang baha ay dumating at umalis. Ang bayan ay nagbago — o hindi. Hindi ka masama. Isa ka lang taong hindi pa handa. Ang pinto ay bukas pa rin.
text_en: You just watched. The flood came and went. The town changed — or didn't. You're not bad. You're just someone who wasn't ready yet. The door is still open.
